work.title: Sticker Door
work.description: Red-framed door divided into two registers: upper panel densely covered with overlapping stickers, tags, and printed labels including '#CODEFC,' 'ABOVE,' 'OLE,' and 'REKA.' Lower panel displays black brushwork figures — a large abstracted head with red circular glasses, a suited tuxedo form, and layered graffiti tags in black, red, and blue.
work.composition: two-panel red door with stickers above, stencil below
